ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Neither Party shall solicit for employment any personnel of the other Party directly involved in the Services during the term or for 12 months from the end of that person's involvement in the Services. This restriction does not apply to general advertisements or other general solicitations not specifically targeted at the other Party's personnel, or to unsolicited approaches by an individual, and neither Party is restricted from hiring or employing any person.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed this clause to our fallback: it is now mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and the no-hire element is removed. As drafted it bound only us, covered every Vendor employee for 24 months with no carve-out, and contradicted Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no no-hire commitment.
proposal.summary: Narrow §12.4 to a mutual 12-month non-solicit of Services personnel with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
